from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
import json, hashlib, re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
root = Path.cwd()
out = root / "reports/research/510300_original_operating_counterexample_causes_v1"
def save(name, value):
    path = out / name
    if path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("已有原解析产物，禁止覆盖：" + str(path))
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
results = json.loads((out / "五原期有限首次取得完成_E111.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
for receipt in results["results"]:
    if receipt["status_code"] != 200:
        continue
    data = (root / receipt["raw_path"]).read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != receipt["raw_sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("原载体与首次回执不符")
    html = data.decode("utf-8")
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    metas = [{key: str(tag.get(key, "")) for key in ("name", "content", "property", "http-equiv")} for tag in soup.find_all("meta")]
    editors = soup.select("div.TRS_Editor, div.TRS_UEDITOR, div.TRS_PreAppend")
    if not editors:
        editors = soup.select(".TRS_Editor, .TRS_UEDITOR, .TRS_PreAppend")
    bodies = []
    for node in editors:
        paragraphs = []
        for tag in node.find_all(["p", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "li", "tr"], recursive=True):
            text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", tag.get_text(" ", strip=True)).strip()
            if text:
                paragraphs.append(text)
        if not paragraphs:
            text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", node.get_text(" ", strip=True)).strip()
            if text:
                paragraphs = [text]
        text = "\n".join(paragraphs)
        bodies.append({"tag": node.name, "classes": node.get("class"), "paragraphs": paragraphs, "normalized_sha256": hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()})
    unique = []
    seen = set()
    for body in bodies:
        if body["normalized_sha256"] not in seen:
            seen.add(body["normalized_sha256"])
            unique.append(body)
    visible = soup.get_text(" ", strip=True)
    date_context = [visible[max(0, match.start()-100):match.end()+130] for match in re.finditer(r"(?:发布日期|发布时间|成文日期|2019[/年-]0?5[/月-]27|2024[/年-]0?1[/月-]27|2024[/年-]0?3[/月-]27)", visible)]
    article_title = soup.title.get_text(" ", strip=True) if soup.title else None
    record = {"economic_period": receipt["economic_period"], "url": receipt["requested_url"], "raw_path": receipt["raw_path"], "raw_sha256": receipt["raw_sha256"], "retrieval_receipt_time": receipt["ended_at"], "article_title": article_title, "all_meta_fields": metas, "editor_body_count": len(bodies), "distinct_editor_bodies": unique, "duplicate_editor_bodies_are_not_independent_sources": True, "visible_date_contexts": date_context, "own_clock_admission_not_yet_decided": True, "complete_body_read_before_attribution": True}
    save(receipt["economic_period"] + "_同原完整正文与时钟证据_E111.json", record)
    print(json.dumps({"economic_period": record["economic_period"], "article_title": article_title, "metas": [item for item in metas if any(part in (item["name"] + item["property"]).lower() for part in ("date", "title", "source", "author", "description"))], "editor_body_count": len(bodies), "unique_body_count": len(unique), "date_context": date_context, "full_original_body": unique}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
